name: Kisbodak (Hungary)
description: White field with a row of green triangles along the top edge and a row of blue triangles along the bottom edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kisbodak (a green and blue shield with a white tree and a fish) between the name KISBODAK above and a motto below in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
